verdict.rationale: Jeeves's corporate cards page states "1% cashback on every purchase," which documents automatic earning on card spend. Nothing in the pack explains how the cashback is credited or whether founders must redeem it manually, so the 'no manual redemption' half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documentation of automatic crediting or redemption mechanics (e.g. statement credit or auto-deposit), cashback terms, caps or exclusions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
